skill_name: Curate 5 examples of effective communication techniques.
workflow: Five examples of effective communication techniques include active listening, asking clarifying questions, using direct, non-judgmental language, giving feedback constructively, and using open-ended questions. Active listening allows a speaker to hear what someone is saying, comprehend it, and provide a response.
